title: bug: .moe/pins/ (chat pins, daemon runtime) is not gitignored, so every landing sees it as unattributed dirt
description:
Observed on 2026-10-30 at 11:53Z. qa-ba3f4f35's landing for task-4b0609d1 refused with MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ADOPTED_NO_BASELINE: "refusing to land 47 unattributed shared dirty path(s)". One of them is `?? .moe/pins/`. It is untracked and stays that way: it held chan-15c8e232.json from 00:22Z and chan-b6d8273b.json from 13:48Z.

Cause: StateManager's chat store (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/chatStore.ts writePins, ~L477) writes `.moe/pins/<channelId>.json`, and init_project creates the `pins` dir (tools/initProject.ts:63). Neither ignore file covers it:
- The repo root .gitignore lists .moe/messages/, workers/, teams/ and the other runtime dirs (lines ~68-79), but not .moe/pins/.
- The generated GITIGNORE_CONTENT for other projects' .moe/.gitignore (packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts ~L838-850) lists daemon.json, daemon.lock, workers/, proposals/ and the delivery record dirs, but not pins/.
Pins point at message ids that live only in the gitignored messages/, so committed pins would dangle.

Fix:
- Add `.moe/pins/` to the root .gitignore beside .moe/messages/.
- Add `pins/` to the generator's runtime list. Edit the source the prebuild stamps from, never initFiles.ts by hand. Through the existing header-guarded migration, already-initialized projects then pick it up.
- Update CLAUDE.md's "Only the runtime subset (...) is gitignored" sentence and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's .moe tree.

Out of scope: messages/ in other projects' generated .gitignore, and existing committed history.
definitionOfDone: `git check-ignore .moe/pins/chan-x.json` matches in this repo, and a freshly init_project'd project's .moe/.gitignore lists pins/. Shown by a daemon test over the generated gitignore content.
An already-initialized project whose .moe/.gitignore carries the Moe runtime header gains pins/ through the existing migration, with nothing else changed. Shown by a test.
CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md name pins/ as runtime, and `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0.

implementationPlan.description: 1. Complete repository runtime-ignore policy (DoD1; prerequisite tests retained). Read child producer's landed generator/tests and ensure it delivers pins/ fresh/init migration; do not reimplement it here. Add only `.moe/pins/` adjacent to `.moe/messages/` in root .gitignore. Keep all other ignore entries exactly as found; no broad .moe/** pattern, no force-add/untracking/history change and no writes to live .moe. Existing generator's atomic-write/error handling remains unchanged and is tested by the prerequisite. Reuse its test cases unchanged at final gate; confirm git check-ignore resolves a synthetic pins path to this exact new root rule, not a user/global exclude.

2. Document the runtime relationship (DoD3). Add pins/ to CLAUDE.md's 'Only the runtime subset' list and to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's .moe tree as local runtime/gitignored chat pins. Explain succinctly that pins reference message IDs in local message history, so versioning pins would leave dangling links elsewhere. Preserve distinctions between versioned board state and runtime, and between this repo's messages ignore and generated-project messages behavior (explicitly outside scope). No promise that ignoring provides security or deletes old history, and no unrelated doc sweep.

3. Single final integration verification for both pins slices (DoD1–3). From root run exactly `git check-ignore -v -- .moe/pins/chan-x.json && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test)`. Require check-ignore output identifies root .gitignore's `.moe/pins/` rule and the synthetic path, full daemon suite exits0 and child's generated-content/fresh-write/migration/custom-preservation/idempotence/error tests execute. Do not regenerate here merely to absorb other sessions' pending doc changes; child must have landed a source-consistent artifact. Inspect generated runtime array against source read-only. The prerequisite tests exercise actual writeInitFiles used by init_project on owned temp dirs. Load regression-check/verification-before-completion, retain exact fresh command/exitCode/outputTail. No real pin file or fixture needs creating in live .moe.

4. Final adversarial self-review once, covering the combined pins feature. Load adversarial-self-review. Confirm only pins runtime policy changed, all three original DoD items now proven across dependency+parent, header-preserved migration appends only missing pins to an otherwise current file, CRLF/custom/no-header behavior preserved, generated source+artifact agree, and repeat startup cannot duplicate lines. Inspect own three-file diff plus dependency's relevant hunks read-only; never include peers' docs/runtime bytes. Ensure no committed history rewrite or claims that ignore is a security boundary. Fix within owned scope and refresh same gate, then complete via Moe with true modifiedFiles/evidence; wrapper owns Git writes.
